messages.subject: denotation of X chromosome?
parts:
Dr. Broman, 

While I was running the non parametric interval mapping on R/qtl I realized that the program might not be reading the Chr1 in the cross object as ChrX (chr 1 contains all the chrX markers). I realized this when the code: 

#nonparametric interval mapping 
map_athaf2=calc.genoprob(map_athaf2, step=1, error.prob=0.001)
out.np=scanone(map_athaf2, model="np")

plot(out.np, ylab="LOD score", alternate.chrid = TRUE)

#permutation test to perform X chromosome-specific permutations
operm.np= scanone(map_athaf2, model="np", n.perm=1000, perm.Xsp = TRUE)

#the 5% LOD thresholds are the following 
summary(operm.np, 0.05)

resulted in: 
> summary(operm.np, 0.05)
LOD thresholds (1000 permutations)
    lod
5% 2.72

But the book shows that there are different permutations for the autosomes and X chromosome. Is the program just not reading Chr1 as ChrX? If so, ss there a specific way to denote Chr1 as ChrX? Thank you so much!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] denotation of X chromosome?
parts:
You need to change the "class" of that chromosome from A to X

    class(map_athaf2$geno[["1"]]) <- "X"

karl
